contentEn:
A kitchen renovation in Surrey, BC costs between $35,000 and $150,000 or more in 2026, depending on the size of the space, the quality of materials and the scope of the project. At the lower end, a cosmetic refresh — new paint, updated lighting and refaced cabinets — can run $35,000 to $55,000. A mid-range gut renovation with new cabinetry, quartz countertops and updated electrical typically lands between $55,000 and $95,000. A full custom kitchen with structural changes, premium appliances and bespoke finishes regularly reaches $120,000 to $150,000 or more.

Reno Stars has completed multiple kitchen renovation projects in Surrey, BC, ranging from single-wall refreshes to complete layout reconfigurations. This guide breaks down real 2026 pricing based on actual completed Surrey projects so Surrey homeowners can budget accurately before signing a contract.

What Drives Kitchen Renovation Cost in Surrey, BC?

Four factors determine the budget for a Surrey kitchen renovation: the size of the kitchen, the quality of finishes, the complexity of the layout and whether any structural work is involved. Surrey homes range from 1970s-1990s ranches in Guildford and Fleetwood to newer townhouses in Clayton and Willoughby, and each presents different renovation challenges. Older homes may require electrical upgrades to meet current code, which adds to the overall budget. A kitchen island with seating, for example, requires dedicated electrical outlets on their own circuit — a code requirement that adds $800-$1,500 per outlet.

Surrey Kitchen Renovation Cost by Scope (2026)

These price ranges reflect 2026 material and labour costs in Surrey, BC, based on completed Reno Stars projects. All prices are in Canadian dollars.

Kitchen Renovation Labour Costs in Surrey, BC

Labour typically accounts for 35-45% of a Surrey kitchen renovation budget. Electrical work runs $85-$130 per hour, plumbing at $90-$140 per hour, and general carpentry at $75-$115 per hour. A mid-size kitchen renovation requires approximately 200-350 labour hours across all trades. Surrey municipality requires a building permit for any work that modifies plumbing, electrical or structural elements, and the permit fee is based on the declared project value.

Surrey-Specific Cost Considerations

Surrey's geographic spread means material delivery logistics vary by neighbourhood — Guildford and South Surrey can face longer lead times than centrally located Newton. BC's Harmonized Sales Tax (HST) of 12% applies to labour and services for full-scale renovations, which is factored into the all-in prices above. If your Surrey home was built before 1990, an electrical panel assessment is recommended before starting work, as many older panels need upgrading to support modern appliance loads.

Kitchen Renovation Timeline in Surrey, BC

A cosmetic Surrey kitchen refresh typically takes 3-5 weeks. A mid-range gut renovation requires 8-12 weeks from permit approval to final walkthrough. High-end custom kitchens with structural changes can take 14-20 weeks, as custom cabinetry alone requires 6-10 weeks for manufacturing and delivery. Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule before construction begins, including milestones for each trade stage.

Surrey Kitchen Materials: What to Budget For

Cabinetry is the largest single expense, accounting for 25-35% of most Surrey kitchen budgets. Thermofoil or laminate cabinets start around $150-$300 per linear foot, solid wood or MDF with paint finish at $400-$700 per linear foot, and bespoke custom cabinetry at $800-$1,400 per linear foot. Quartz and granite countertops range from $65-$150 per square foot installed. Flooring materials — luxury vinyl plank, tile or hardwood — add $6-$25 per square foot depending on the product chosen.

A Surrey homeowner who renovated two bathrooms alongside their kitchen reported a combined budget of $95,000 for both spaces, with cabinet and countertop costs representing the largest single line items.

Surrey Kitchen Renovation FAQs

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Surrey, BC in 2026?

A Surrey kitchen renovation costs $35,000 to $150,000 or more in 2026. A cosmetic refresh starts around $35,000, a mid-range gut renovation typically runs $55,000 to $95,000, and a high-end custom kitchen with premium finishes can exceed $150,000.

Do I need a building permit for a kitchen renovation in Surrey?

Yes. Surrey requires a building permit for any work that modifies plumbing, electrical, structural elements or the layout of a kitchen. A cosmetic refresh with no plumbing or electrical changes may not require a permit, but anything involving new circuits, gas lines or wall removal needs one.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Surrey, BC?

A cosmetic refresh takes 3-5 weeks. A mid-range gut renovation typically requires 8-12 weeks from permit approval to completion. High-end custom kitchens with structural changes take 14-20 weeks due to custom cabinetry lead times of 6-10 weeks.

Does BC HST apply to kitchen renovations in Surrey?

Yes. BC's Harmonized Sales Tax (HST) of 12% applies to labour and services for full-scale residential renovations in Surrey. Material purchases may be subject to GST at 5%, which is passed through to the homeowner by the contractor.

What is the biggest expense in a Surrey kitchen renovation?

Cabinetry is the largest single expense, typically representing 25-35% of the total budget. Custom or semi-custom cabinetry for a mid-size Surrey kitchen can cost $25,000 to $60,000 depending on materials and configuration. Countertops are the second-largest line item at $8,000 to $20,000 for quartz or granite in a standard kitchen.
contentZh:
薩里（Surrey）廚房裝修費用在2026年介乎35,000至150,000加元或以上，視乎面積、材料品質及工程範圍而定。低預算裝修——新油漆、更新照明及更換櫃門——費用約為35,000至55,000加元。中等規模全面裝修，配有新櫥櫃、石英石檯面及更新電線工程，費用通常在55,000至95,000加元之間。配備定制櫥櫃、優質電器及訂製飾面的高端廚房，費用可達120,000至150,000加元或以上。

聚星裝修已完成多個薩里廚房裝修項目。本指南基於已完成的薩里項目，分享2026年真實價格資料，供薩里業主在簽約前準確預算。

影響薩里廚房裝修費用的因素

薩里廚房裝修預算取決於四個因素：廚房面積、飾面品質、佈局複雜度及是否涉及結構工程。薩里住宅從Guildford和Fleetwood的1970至1990年代平房，到Clayton和Willoughby的較新聯排別墅，各有不同的裝修挑戰。較舊房屋可能需要升級電線以符合現行規範。

薩里廚房裝修費用明細（2026年）

工程範圍2026年預估費用包含項目
表面更新$35,000 - $55,000油漆、更新照明、櫃門更新或新櫃門、硬件更換、瓷磚背板
中等全面裝修$55,000 - $95,000新櫥櫃、石英石或花崗岩檯面、更新電線/水管、新地板、排氣罩
高端定制廚房$95,000 - $150,000+定制櫥櫃、優質電器（Wolf、Miele、Thermador）、石材檯面、结构工程、照明設計

薩里廚房裝修人工費用

人工通常佔薩里廚房裝修預算的35%至45%。電工費用為每小時85至130加元，水管工為每小時90至140加元，木工為每小時75至115加元。中型廚房裝修需要約200至350小時的各工種人工。

薩里廚房材料預算建議

櫥櫃是最大單項開支，通常佔總預算的25%至35%。熱壓成型或層壓板櫥櫃起價約每直線英尺150至300加元，實木或MDF烤漆櫥櫃為每直線英尺400至700加元，定制櫥櫃為每直線英尺800至1,400加元。石英石及花崗岩檯面連安裝費用為每平方英尺65至150加元。

薩里廚房裝修時間線

薩里廚房表面更新通常需要3至5週。中等全面裝修從許可證批准到最終驗收需要8至12週。高端定制廚房可能需要14至20週。

薩里廚房裝修常見問題

2026年薩里廚房裝修多少錢？

薩里廚房裝修費用在2026年介乎35,000至150,000加元或以上。表面更新起價約35,000加元，中等全面裝修通常為55,000至95,000加元，高端定制廚房可超過150,000加元。

薩里廚房裝修需要建築許可證嗎？

需要。薩里要求對任何涉及水管、電線結構元素或廚房佈局改動的工程申請建築許可證。

薩里廚房裝修需要多長時間？

表面更新需要3至5週。中等全面裝修通常需要8至12週。高端定制廚房需要14至20週。

薩里廚房裝修中最大的開支是什麼？

櫥櫃是最大單項開支，通常佔總預算的25%至35%。中型薩里廚房的定制櫥櫃費用可達25,000至60,000加元。檯面為第二大項目，費用為8,000至20,000加元。
